Package io.webagent4j.extraction.api

Interface IExtractionValidator<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the validated value's type
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface IExtractionValidator<T>
Validates one already-converted extraction value. Validation always runs after conversion has already succeeded - see ExtractionRequest's raw-to-convert-to-validate pipeline.
